notes.desc: treated as a stationary object in the AM16 patch

triggers.method: Open the south window along the ledge
Frob the telescope by the window
Push the button in the firepit
Pull the book on the north bookcase
Frob the east torch in the hallway
Push the button on the statue
Pull the lever on the east side of the door

rewards.rewardOther: A lever that controls the alarm in Karras's office
